name: CPM DF-8
description:
The CPM DF-8 Analog Dynamic Multi-filter is the latest in Stylophone's Pro Audio range. Dubbed "Beauty and the Beast," this unique filter box combines the precision of a smooth analog recreation of the classic 2045 Lowpass filter with the bold, dynamic character of Stylophone's proprietary GEN R-8 filter.

The DF-8 is much more than a dual filter box. It's a sound design tool, equipped with two white noise sources, a sample-and-hold modulation source with adjustable slew, and a crunchy PT2399 delay with modulation. It serves as a versatile sound source capable of everything from subtle atmospheres to all-out sonic chaos.

With two channels and eight filter types — including Lowpass, Bandpass, Highpass, Notch, and three hybrid modes (Bandpass +, Notch+, Bandstop +) — the DF-8 delivers an expansive tonal range, from smooth sweeps to snarling distortion.

Like all CPM units, the CPM DF-8 is designed for portability and flexibility. Stylophone's unique enclosure design with side ribs allows multiple CPM units to be locked together, for stability like a large modular, and for easy insertion into a Eurorack desk. It also features a built-in 2W speaker, 6 AA battery slots, and multiple 3.5 mm in/outs.
